categories.name: Personnel
categories.definition: A person holding a specific role, rank, title, or profession, such as a soldier, politician, academic, or artist.

categories.name: Competition
categories.definition: An achievement or outcome in a sporting or competitive context, such as winning a medal or a specific placement.

categories.name: Family
categories.definition: A familial or romantic relationship role, such as wife, husband, or mistress.

categories.name: Conflict
categories.definition: An event or action related to physical violence, war, crime, or protest.

categories.name: Governance
categories.definition: An administrative or leadership position within an organization, government, or military, such as president, director, or commander.

categories.name: Employment
categories.definition: A work-related activity, status, or event, such as a job, hiring, resignation, or retirement.

categories.name: Education
categories.definition: An academic activity, role, or institution, such as being a student, professor, or attending a school.

categories.name: Arts
categories.definition: A creative work, performance, or medium, such as a film, song, or album.

categories.name: Legal
categories.definition: A legal action, proceeding, or status, such as a trial, arrest, or sentence.

categories.name: Life
categories.definition: A significant personal life event or status, such as marriage, divorce, or death.

categories.name: Movement
categories.definition: Physical motion, travel, or transportation of people or objects.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: An act of conveying information, such as a statement, speech, or interview.

categories.name: Business
categories.definition: A commercial activity, transaction, or financial event.

categories.name: Other
categories.definition: A general event, action, or abstract concept not covered by other categories.
